title: Old People's Home, Magill - Interior of Kitchen(GN01782).jpg
creator: State Government Photographer
description:
The Old Folk's Home situated in Magill opened in 1917. Sometimes referred to as the Old People's Home, it was the state-run institution for needy elderly people and replaced the outdated facilities at the Desitute Asylum on Kintore Ave in the city. The new home accommodated around 350 people in bungalow-style dormitories for men and women, married accommodation and infirmary wards. The up-to-date steam laundry and kitchen were separate. The 20 acre site had panoramic views of Adelaide. (Register, 28 February 1917, p4). The facility operated until 1986.
